verdicts.defect: The narrowing is coded but never runs, because `baselineRef()` in extensions.ts:2250 cannot execute. Its script is assembled as an array joined with ' ; ', and the second element ends in `do`, so the join inserts a stray semicolon: `for r in refs/barn/published/oci refs/barn/published/local ; do ; git rev-parse ...`. The pod's /bin/sh (dash) answers `Syntax error: ";" unexpected` and exits 2 - I captured that frame off the exec WebSocket on a live page load, and reproduced it by hand in the pod; removing the stray `;` prints KIND=refs/barn/published/local and SHA=24b3922... correctly. `inPackage` returns only stdout, so baselineRef sees '' and returns {kind:'none', sha:'', label:'this extension has no history yet...'}. review.vue's readStates() then short-circuits on `!this.baseline.sha` and returns {}, so `committed` is always empty, `discardable` is always every file, no Keep box is ever disabled, committedNote never renders and discardLabel is always 'Discard all'. Fix: drop the ' ; ' before the `git rev-parse` element (or join that pair with a space). Same call is used by BuildFailure.vue and studio/PreviewPanel.vue, so their baseline sentences are wrong for the same reason.
